selection.name: all_features
selection.calibration_protocol: Base/feature/family/ensemble selection only before February. Fit calibrators Feb 1–14; choose using Feb 15–28 log loss. Gate validation uses those genuinely held-out predictions. Refit the chosen calibrator on all February out-of-sample raw predictions, then fit base models through Feb 28. No March labels enter any choice.

quarter_kelly.policy: Quarter Kelly, 0–5% per bet; simultaneous games use start-of-Eastern-date bankroll; no within-day recycling.

hindsight_quarter_kelly.policy: Quarter Kelly, 0–5% per bet; simultaneous games use start-of-Eastern-date bankroll; no within-day recycling.

confidence_intervals.method: Percentile bootstrap of whole Eastern calendar dates; fixed fitted model and fixed gate.

hindsight_confidence_intervals.method: Percentile bootstrap of whole Eastern calendar dates; fixed fitted model and fixed gate.

v2.method: Refit the frozen published v2 specification; no v2 hyperparameter search is rerun.
known_limitations: v2 chooses calibration by in-sample February calibration loss; preserved for exact reproduction only.
v2's 1PM early-tip routing can use a report at tip for a 1PM game; v3 requires strict snapshot < tip.
v2 ORB denominator uses opposing OREB instead of opposing DREB; v3 corrects this.
v2 injury minutes are double-lagged and season-to-date denominators are off by one; v3 corrects both.

unusable_injury_snapshots.injury_source_issue: Only incomplete pre-tip injury reports for 2021-12-31 PHX@BOS

features.test_fallback_policy: Before evaluation, any incomplete March feature row is assigned Kaggle no-vig market probability for every ablation. Never remove a benchmark game or fabricate an opening quote.

timestamp_policy.statistics: Completed games with source date strictly less than target date; rolling last 10, minimum 5, EWMA half-life 10.
timestamp_policy.opening: Only odds_date == open; no marker publication timestamp exists. Semantic historical opening, not exact point-in-time provable.
timestamp_policy.closing: Kaggle supplied closing moneylines are the sole current closing market input and settlement price; actual publication timestamps unavailable.
timestamp_policy.movement: Current game close/move/steam/update-count fields are never predictors. Historical versions use strictly previous game dates; timed updates restricted to that game's Eastern calendar day.
timestamp_policy.injuries: Latest complete official snapshot with Eastern timestamp strictly less than scheduled Eastern tip; 1–11 in the 12-hour cache are afternoon/evening.
timestamp_policy.march: Weights and selections freeze before March. Earlier completed March games update statistics, never model weights.

protocol.primary_selection: Lowest pre-February ensemble CV log loss across all five registered configurations; ties prefer registration order.
